Customer: Yes, yes, that's right. The auto-debit, I know about that.

Agent: Perfect. So here's what I need from you — when your salary comes in on the 12th or 13th, I need you to make sure there's enough balance in that account for the auto-debit to go through on the 15th. Can you commit to that? That you'll maintain sufficient balance for the debit?

Customer: <interruption> Yes, of course. I mean, once the salary comes, I'll have the money. I'll make sure the 18,500 is sitting there on the 15th so the auto-debit can take it.

Agent: Excellent. And just to be clear — you're not planning to withdraw that amount or use it for something else before the 15th, right? You'll keep it reserved for the EMI?

Customer: No, no, I won't touch it. I know the EMI is important. I'll keep the balance there. My wife also knows about this, so she won't spend it either. We've discussed it at home.

Agent: That's very responsible of you, Rajesh. I'm going to note down that you've committed to maintaining a balance of at least 18,500 rupees in your account from the 13th onwards, so the auto-debit can process smoothly on the 15th. Is that correct?

Customer: Yes, that's correct. The 13th, the money comes, and I'll keep it there for the auto-debit. No problem.

Agent: Great. And Rajesh, just one more thing — if for any reason your salary gets delayed further, or if something unexpected happens, you'll call us immediately, yes? Don't wait for us to call you again.

Customer: Yes, yes, I will call. But I'm quite confident the salary will come by the 13th. It's just a small delay this month. Everything should be fine.

Agent: Perfect. I'm going to update your account right now with this commitment. We'll monitor the auto-debit on the 15th, and if it goes through successfully, we won't need to contact you again for this month. But if there's any issue, we'll reach out. Does that sound good?

Customer: Yes, that sounds good. Thank you for understanding about the salary delay.

Agent: You're welcome, Rajesh. Thank you for being cooperative and for committing to maintain the balance. We appreciate it. Have a good day.
